protocol.validation: one rotating validation study per outer held-out study; not exhaustive nested CV
protocol.preprocessing: refit using only each fold's training samples; no test self-supervision
protocol.label_budget: subject-stratified training labels; all training inputs available to every arm
protocol.training_selection: fixed architectures and step budgets; validation selects checkpoints/C, never test
protocol.compute_comparison: equal supervised steps for scratch and finetuning; pretrained arm has extra unsupervised compute
protocol.statistics: each study averages seeds before macro averaging; seeds are not independent people or studies
protocol.limitations: Descriptive benchmark, not confirmatory significance testing. Related training sets overlap across outer folds. Fixed LR and simple baselines need broader tuning in real research. No clinical claim.

half_label_branch_smoke.note: Two-fold branch execution check; not a full label-efficiency study.

scientific_limits: All supplied numerical model performance is from synthetic teaching data, not real disease prediction or clinical validation.

In the full six-study synthetic benchmark the logistic baseline outperformed every complex model. The 0.0125 mean fine-tuned-minus-scratch AUROC difference is descriptive, not a significance or biological-benefit claim.
Each outer test study has one rotating validation study; the benchmark is not exhaustive nested cross-validation. Each fold fits preprocessing and pretraining without the outer test study.
Two seeds are not two additional independent studies. Per-study paired subject bootstrap conditions on the fitted models and test study; it excludes retraining and between-study uncertainty.

The R curatedMetagenomicData exporter was checked against pinned official source and maintainer analyses. Its base-R sample contract is tested separately in CI. Real Bioconductor resource download, full exporter integration and real-cohort training were not executed.

Evidence retrieval, prompt export and a real localhost TinyGPT HTTP/NDJSON service are implemented. External text-generation integration and production agent/serving systems remain extensions; the local service has no public authentication, multi-request scheduler or KV cache.
Large-scale QLoRA, full RLHF, AMP/multi-GPU execution, DNA/protein foundation-model training and real clinical multimodal experiments remain documented extensions.
The complete-resume experiment validates the provided CPU configuration at optimizer-step boundaries; it does not establish bitwise determinism on other hardware or distributed loaders.

New distillation, dual-encoder retrieval, graph, VAE, diffusion-coordinate, missingness and conformal examples are small mechanism experiments. Teacher agreement, training retrieval hits, known-noise recovery and synthetic coverage are not real-world task validity.
